limitations: Derived amounts are changes in reported accounting amounts, including adjustments; not pure cash payments, accident-month claims, or earned premiums.
Exact gross/net, cancellation, incurred/paid and reserve mapping remains unresolved.
Only Automobile/Nacional is authorized; foreign categories and currency aggregation are excluded.
Current snapshots cannot prove what was known at historical dates. Actual release lags and revision vintages are unresolved.
An institution code is never bridged to another code. Name changes within a code receive review flags.
Missing or ambiguous prior months are never filled, interpolated or assumed zero.
